translations: And so that may purify Allah
puzzle.hint: A powerful message of courage and perseverance for true believers, revealed in the context of the Battle of Uhud.
puzzle.arabic: وَلِيُمَحِّصَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَيَمْحَقَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
puzzle.verseEn: And that Allāh may purify the believers [through trials] and destroy the disbelievers.
